<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>EduPath Global — Your Study Abroad Roadmap</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;500;600&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  :root {
    --blue: #1A5FA8;
    --blue-light: #E8F1FB;
    --blue-mid: #2D7DD2;
    --blue-dark: #0C3D72;
    --teal: #0F7B6C;
    --teal-light: #E0F5F1;
    --gold: #C89B2A;
    --gold-light: #FBF3DC;
    --text: #1A1A2E;
    --text-muted: #5A6072;
    --text-light: #8A93A6;
    --bg: #FAFAF8;
    --bg-card: #FFFFFF;
    --border: rgba(26,95,168,0.12);
    --border-strong: rgba(26,95,168,0.25);
    --radius: 14px;
    --radius-sm: 8px;
    --shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(26,95,168,0.08);
    --shadow-hover: 0 8px 40px rgba(26,95,168,0.15);
  }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); line-height: 1.6; }

  /* NAV */
  nav {
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    padding: 1rem 2.5rem; background: rgba(250,250,248,0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;
  }
  .logo { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; }
  .logo span { color: var(--blue); }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; list-style: none; }
  .nav-links a { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--blue); }
  .nav-cta { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; border: none; padding: 9px 22px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, transform .15s; }
  .nav-cta:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }

  /* IG BAR */
  .ig-bar { background: var(--blue-light); padding: .65rem 2rem; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; color: var(--blue-dark); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; }
  .ig-bar a { color: var(--blue); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; }
  .ig-bar a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .ig-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }

  /* HERO */
  .hero { text-align: center; padding: 5rem 2rem 3.5rem; max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .hero-badge { display: inline-block; background: var(--gold-light); color: var(--gold); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 5px 16px; border-radius: 20px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(200,155,42,.2); letter-spacing: .03em; }
  .hero h1 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 50px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; color: var(--text); }
  .hero h1 span { color: var(--blue); }
  .hero p { font-size: 16px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 2.25rem; max-width: 600px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
  .hero-btns { display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 2.25rem; }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; border: none; padding: 13px 30px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, transform .15s, box-shadow .2s; }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(26,95,168,.3); }
  .btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--text); border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong); padding: 13px 30px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s, background .2s; }
  .btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--blue); color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue-light); }

  /* STATS */
  .stats { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 3rem; padding: 1.75rem 2rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); flex-wrap: wrap; background: #fff; }
  .stat { text-align: center; }
  .stat-num { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--blue); }
  .stat-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-light); margin-top: 3px; }

  /* SECTIONS */
  .section { padding: 4rem 2rem; max-width: 1020px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .sec-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .sec-sub { text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
  .divider { height: 1px; background: var(--border); }

  /* HOW IT WORKS */
  .steps-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 1.25rem; }
  .step { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.5rem; transition: box-shadow .2s; }
  .step:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }
  .step-num { width: 36px; height: 36px; background: var(--blue); color: #fff; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: .9rem; }
  .step h3 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: .4rem; }
  .step p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.65; }

  /* PRICING */
  .pricing-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 1.25rem; }
  .plan { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.75rem; position: relative; transition: box-shadow .2s; }
  .plan:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }
  .plan.featured { border: 2px solid var(--blue); }
  .pop-badge { position: absolute; top: -13px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--blue); color: #fff; font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 16px; border-radius: 20px; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 500; }
  .plan-name { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-light); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .plan-price { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: .3rem; }
  .plan-price span { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 400; }
  .plan-desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.55; }
  .plan-features { list-style: none; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .plan-features li { font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 0; display: flex; gap: 9px; align-items: flex-start; color: var(--text-muted); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .plan-features li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .ck { color: var(--teal); font-size: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }
  .plan-btn { width: 100%; padding: 11px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: 1.5px solid var(--blue); background: transparent; color: var(--blue); transition: background .2s, color .2s; }
  .plan-btn:hover { background: var(--blue-light); }
  .plan.featured .plan-btn { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; }
  .plan.featured .plan-btn:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); }

  /* CERTIFICATIONS */
  .cert-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(270px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .cert-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1rem 1.25rem; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; transition: box-shadow .2s; }
  .cert-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .cert-icon { width: 38px; height: 38px; background: var(--blue-light); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .cert-body { flex: 1; }
  .cert-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 3px; }
  .cert-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-light); }
  .cert-del { background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-light); cursor: pointer; font-size: 18px; padding: 0; line-height: 1; margin-left: auto; flex-shrink: 0; transition: color .2s; }
  .cert-del:hover { color: #c0392b; }
  .add-cert-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .add-cert-row input { flex: 1; min-width: 200px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 13px; background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--text); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color .2s; }
  .add-cert-row input:focus { border-color: var(--blue); }
  .add-cert-row button { padding: 9px 20px; background: var(--blue); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .2s; }
  .add-cert-row button:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); }

  /* SCHOLARSHIPS */
  .schol-filters { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 1.75rem; justify-content: center; }
  .filter-btn { padding: 6px 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); transition: all .2s; }
  .filter-btn:hover { border-color: var(--blue); color: var(--blue); }
  .filter-btn.active { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; border-color: var(--blue); }
  .schol-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(290px, 1fr)); gap: 1.1rem; }
  .schol-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.25rem; transition: box-shadow .2s; }
  .schol-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }
  .schol-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: .6rem; gap: 8px; }
  .schol-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; flex: 1; line-height: 1.4; }
  .country-tag { font-size: 11px; background: var(--blue-light); color: var(--blue-dark); padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; font-weight: 500; }
  .schol-val { font-size: 13px; color: var(--blue); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: .4rem; }
  .schol-row { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: .2rem; line-height: 1.55; }
  .schol-row span { color: var(--text); }
  .schol-link { display: inline-block; margin-top: .7rem; font-size: 12px; color: var(--blue); border: 1px solid var(--blue); padding: 4px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, color .2s; }
  .schol-link:hover { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; }

  /* TESTIMONIALS */
  .tcard-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)); gap: 1.25rem; }
  .tcard { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.5rem; }
  .tcard p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 1.1rem; font-style: italic; }
  .tauthor { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  .avatar { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blue-light); color: var(--blue-dark); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .aname { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }
  .adest { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-light); }

  /* FORM */
  .form-section { background: #f0f4f9; padding: 4rem 2rem; }
  .form-wrap { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .form-wrap .sec-title, .form-wrap .sec-sub { margin-bottom: .4rem; }
  .form-wrap .sec-sub { margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  .form-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 2rem 2rem 1.5rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .form-progress { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .fp { flex: 1; min-width: 80px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; padding: 7px 4px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); cursor: pointer; background: #f0f4f9; color: var(--text-muted); border: 1px solid var(--border); transition: all .2s; }
  .fp.active { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; border-color: var(--blue); }
  .fp.done { background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal); border-color: rgba(15,123,108,.3); }
  .form-step { display: none; }
  .form-step.visible { display: block; }
  .fs-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; padding-bottom: .75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .field-group { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
  .field label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 500; }
  .field input, .field select, .field textarea { padding: 9px 13px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 13px; background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--text); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color .2s; }
  .field input:focus, .field select:focus, .field textarea:focus { border-color: var(--blue); }
  .field textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 90px; }
  .form-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 1.5rem; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .step-indicator { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-light); }
  .form-nav-btns { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
  .btn-back { padding: 9px 20px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--text); transition: border-color .2s; }
  .btn-back:hover { border-color: var(--blue); color: var(--blue); }
  .btn-next { padding: 9px 22px; background: var(--blue); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s; }
  .btn-next:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); }
  .submit-btn { width: 100%; padding: 13px; background: var(--blue); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 1rem; transition: background .2s, transform .15s; }
  .submit-btn:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .success-msg { text-align: center; padding: 2.5rem; display: none; }
  .success-icon { width: 56px; height: 56px; background: var(--teal-light); border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin: 0 auto 1rem; font-size: 24px; color: var(--teal); }
  .success-msg h3 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .success-msg p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; }

  /* CTA */
  .cta-block { text-align: center; padding: 4rem 2rem; background: var(--blue); color: #fff; }
  .cta-block h2 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: .75rem; }
  .cta-block p { color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  .cta-block .btn-primary { background: #fff; color: var(--blue); }
  .cta-block .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-light); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2); }

  /* FOOTER */
  footer { text-align: center; padding: 1.5rem 2rem; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-light); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); line-height: 1.9; }
  footer a { color: var(--blue); text-decoration: none; }
  footer a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    nav { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; }
    .nav-links { display: none; }
    .hero { padding: 3rem 1.25rem 2rem; }
    .section, .cert-section { padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem; }
    .form-section { padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem; }
    .form-card { padding: 1.25rem; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav>
  <a class="logo" href="#">EduPath <span>Global</span></a>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="#how">How it works</a></li>
    <li><a href="#plans">Plans</a></li>
    <li><a href="#scholarships">Scholarships</a></li>
    <li><a href="#certifications">Certifications</a></li>
    <li><a href="#apply">Apply</a></li>
  </ul>
  <button class="nav-cta" onclick="document.getElementById('apply').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">Apply now</button>
</nav>

<!-- INSTAGRAM BAR -->
<div class="ig-bar">
  <span class="ig-icon">
    <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#1A5FA8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="20" rx="5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><circle cx="17.5" cy="6.5" r="1.2" fill="#1A5FA8" stroke="none"/></svg>
  </span>
  Follow us on Instagram:&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/edupathglobal_16?igsh=ZDdidnJpdmVjeDl1" target="_blank">@edupathglobal_16</a>
</div>

<!-- HERO -->
<div class="hero">
  <div class="hero-badge">Trusted study abroad guidance</div>
  <h1>Your personalised <span>university roadmap</span>, built around your profile</h1>
  <p>Share your academic details — CGPA, qualifications, preferred country, and budget — and receive a curated plan of universities you can realistically get into, with deadlines, scholarships, and visa guidance.</p>
  <div class="hero-btns">
    <button class="btn-primary" onclick="document.getElementById('apply').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">Submit my profile</button>
    <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="document.getElementById('how').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">See how it works</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- STATS -->
<div class="stats">
  <div class="stat"><div class="stat-num">200+</div><div class="stat-label">Students guided</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="stat-num">15+</div><div class="stat-label">Countries covered</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="stat-num">85%</div><div class="stat-label">Acceptance rate</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="stat-num">PKR 10K</div><div class="stat-label">Starting from</div></div>
</div>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- HOW IT WORKS -->
<div class="section" id="how">
  <div class="sec-title">How it works</div>
  <div class="sec-sub">Four simple steps from profile to acceptance</div>
  <div class="steps-grid">
    <div class="step"><div class="step-num">1</div><h3>Share your profile</h3><p>Submit your CGPA, qualifications, certificates, preferred country, and budget.</p></div>
    <div class="step"><div class="step-num">2</div><h3>Profile analysis</h3><p>We assess your academic standing and match you to realistic universities and programs.</p></div>
    <div class="step"><div class="step-num">3</div><h3>Receive your roadmap</h3><p>Get a structured plan with shortlisted universities, deadlines, and scholarship options.</p></div>
    <div class="step"><div class="step-num">4</div><h3>Apply with confidence</h3><p>Follow your personalised timeline and application strategy to maximise your chances.</p></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- PLANS -->
<div class="section" id="plans">
  <div class="sec-title">Choose your plan</div>
  <div class="sec-sub">From a quick profile scan to a full 12-month application roadmap</div>
  <div class="pricing-grid">
    <div class="plan">
      <div class="plan-name">Plan 1</div>
      <div class="plan-price">PKR 10,000</div>
      <div class="plan-desc">Basic roadmap — ideal if you're just exploring your options.</div>
      <ul class="plan-features">
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Profile assessment</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Suggested countries &amp; programs</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>5–7 eligible universities</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Admission requirements per university</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Recommended intake (Fall/Spring)</li>
      </ul>
      <button class="plan-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('apply').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">Get basic plan</button>
    </div>
    <div class="plan featured">
      <div class="pop-badge">Most popular</div>
      <div class="plan-name">Plan 2</div>
      <div class="plan-price">PKR 18,000</div>
      <div class="plan-desc">Advanced strategy — for students serious about a strong shortlist.</div>
      <ul class="plan-features">
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Everything in Plan 1</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>8–12 university shortlist (safe + target)</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Scholarship opportunities</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Required documents checklist</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Application timeline &amp; deadlines</li>
      </ul>
      <button class="plan-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('apply').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">Get advanced plan</button>
    </div>
    <div class="plan">
      <div class="plan-name">Plan 3</div>
      <div class="plan-price">PKR 28,000</div>
      <div class="plan-desc">Complete roadmap — end-to-end support from prep to visa.</div>
      <ul class="plan-features">
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Everything in Plan 2</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>6–12 month preparation timeline</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>IELTS/Duolingo test strategy</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Detailed scholarship requirements</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Visa preparation guidance</li>
        <li><span class="ck">✓</span>Personalised application strategy</li>
      </ul>
      <button class="plan-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('apply').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">Get complete plan</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- CERTIFICATIONS -->
<div class="section" id="certifications">
  <div class="sec-title">Our certifications</div>
  <div class="sec-sub">Recognised credentials and partnerships that back our expertise</div>
  <div class="cert-grid" id="cert-grid"></div>
  <div class="add-cert-row">
    <input type="text" id="cert-title-input" placeholder="Certificate title (e.g. Studying at University of Toronto)" />
    <input type="text" id="cert-sub-input" placeholder="Issuing body or description (optional)" />
    <button onclick="addCert()">+ Add certificate</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- SCHOLARSHIPS -->
<div class="section" id="scholarships">
  <div class="sec-title">Scholarship opportunities</div>
  <div class="sec-sub">Curated fully-funded and partial scholarships available to our students</div>
  <div class="schol-filters" id="schol-filters"></div>
  <div class="schol-grid" id="schol-grid"></div>
</div>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- TESTIMONIALS -->
<div class="section">
  <div class="sec-title">What our students say</div>
  <div class="tcard-grid">
    <div class="tcard"><p>"I had no idea which countries were realistic for my CGPA. The roadmap gave me a clear shortlist and I got into my target university in Germany."</p><div class="tauthor"><div class="avatar">AK</div><div><div class="aname">Ahmed K.</div><div class="adest">Accepted — TU Munich, Germany</div></div></div></div>
    <div class="tcard"><p>"The scholarship list alone was worth the price. I applied for three scholarships I didn't know existed and received partial funding."</p><div class="tauthor"><div class="avatar">SR</div><div><div class="aname">Sara R.</div><div class="adest">Accepted — University of Melbourne</div></div></div></div>
    <div class="tcard"><p>"The 12-month timeline kept me on track. I knew exactly when to take IELTS, when to apply, and what documents to prepare."</p><div class="tauthor"><div class="avatar">FM</div><div><div class="aname">Farhan M.</div><div class="adest">Accepted — University of Toronto</div></div></div></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- APPLY FORM -->
<div class="form-section" id="apply">
  <div class="form-wrap">
    <div class="sec-title">Submit your profile</div>
    <div class="sec-sub">Fill in your details and we'll build a personalised roadmap within 48 hours</div>
    <div class="form-card">
      <div class="form-progress" id="form-progress"></div>
      <div id="success-msg" class="success-msg">
        <div class="success-icon">✓</div>
        <h3>Profile submitted!</h3>
        <p>Thank you! We'll review your details and send your personalised roadmap within 48 hours.</p>
      </div>
      <div id="form-body">
        <div class="form-step visible" data-step="0">
          <div class="fs-title">Basic information</div>
          <div class="field-group">
            <div class="field"><label>Full name</label><input type="text" placeholder="e.g. Ahmed Khan" /></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Email address</label><input type="email" placeholder="you@email.com" /></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-step" data-step="1">
          <div class="fs-title">Academic background</div>
          <div class="field-group">
            <div class="field"><label>Qualification</label>
              <select>
                <option value="">Select...</option>
                <option>Matric / O-Levels</option>
                <option>FSc / A-Levels</option>
                <option>Bachelor's degree</option>
                <option>Master's degree</option>
                <option>Other</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="field"><label>CGPA / Grades / Percentage</label><input type="text" placeholder="e.g. 3.5/4.0 or 85%" /></div>
          </div>
          <div class="field-group">
            <div class="field"><label>Main subjects / field of study</label><input type="text" placeholder="e.g. Computer Science, Business" /></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-step" data-step="2">
          <div class="fs-title">Study preferences</div>
          <div class="field-group">
            <div class="field"><label>Preferred country</label>
              <select>
                <option value="">Select...</option>
                <option>Germany</option><option>Japan</option><option>USA</option>
                <option>UK</option><option>Australia</option><option>Canada</option>
                <option>South Korea</option><option>China</option><option>France</option>
                <option>Sweden</option><option>Switzerland</option><option>Other</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="field"><label>Preferred field / program</label><input type="text" placeholder="e.g. Engineering, MBA" /></div>
          </div>
          <div class="field-group">
            <div class="field"><label>Preferred intake</label>
              <select>
                <option value="">Select...</option>
                <option>Fall (Sep–Oct)</option>
                <option>Spring (Jan–Feb)</option>
                <option>Either</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-step" data-step="3">
          <div class="fs-title">Constraints</div>
          <div class="field-group">
            <div class="field"><label>Budget (PKR per year)</label>
              <select>
                <option value="">Select...</option>
                <option>Under PKR 500K</option>
                <option>PKR 500K – 1M</option>
                <option>PKR 1M – 2M</option>
                <option>PKR 2M+</option>
                <option>Seeking full scholarship</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="field"><label>Language test status</label>
              <select>
                <option value="">Select...</option>
                <option>IELTS taken — please specify score below</option>
                <option>Duolingo taken</option>
                <option>TOEFL taken</option>
                <option>Not yet taken</option>
                <option>Planning to take</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="field-group">
            <div class="field"><label>Language test score (if taken)</label><input type="text" placeholder="e.g. IELTS 6.5" /></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-step" data-step="4">
          <div class="fs-title">Additional information</div>
          <div class="field-group">
            <div class="field"><label>Extracurriculars / achievements</label><textarea placeholder="e.g. debate competitions, volunteer work, internships, awards..."></textarea></div>
          </div>
          <div class="field-group">
            <div class="field"><label>Additional notes or special requirements</label><textarea placeholder="Anything else we should know about your situation or goals..."></textarea></div>
          </div>
          <button class="submit-btn" onclick="submitForm()">Submit my profile — get my roadmap</button>
        </div>
        <div class="form-nav">
          <span class="step-indicator" id="step-indicator">Step 1 of 5</span>
          <div class="form-nav-btns">
            <button class="btn-back" id="btn-back" onclick="navForm(-1)" style="display:none">Back</button>
            <button class="btn-next" id="btn-next" onclick="navForm(1)">Next</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- CTA -->
<div class="cta-block">
  <h2>Ready to map your path abroad?</h2>
  <p>Submit your profile today and receive your personalised university roadmap within 48 hours.</p>
  <button class="btn-primary" onclick="document.getElementById('apply').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">Get started — it's free to apply</button>
</div>

<!-- FOOTER -->
<footer>
  © 2026 EduPath Global · Pakistan · Helping students study abroad<br>
  <a href="https://www.instagram.com/edupathglobal_16?igsh=ZDdidnJpdmVjeDl1" target="_blank">Instagram: @edupathglobal_16</a>
</footer>

<script>
// CERTIFICATIONS
const certs = [
  { title: "Welcome to Munich", sub: "Technical University of Munich · Coursera · Mar 11, 2026", img: "data:image/png;base64," },
  { title: "Studying at Japanese Universities", sub: "University of Tokyo · Coursera · Mar 9, 2026", img: "data:image/png;base64," }
];
function renderCerts() {
  document.getElementById('cert-grid').innerHTML = certs.map((c, i) => {
    const thumb = c.img ? `<img src="${c.img}" alt="${c.title}" style="width:60px;height:42px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid rgba(26,95,168,0.15);cursor:pointer;" onclick="openCertModal(${i})" title="Click to view certificate" />` : `<div class="cert-icon"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#1A5FA8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="6"/><path d="M15.477 12.89L17 22l-5-3-5 3 1.523-9.11"/></svg></div>`;
    const viewLink = c.img ? `<span style="font-size:11px;color:#1A5FA8;cursor:pointer;" onclick="openCertModal(${i})">View certificate →</span>` : '';
    return `<div class="cert-card">${thumb}<div class="cert-body"><div class="cert-title">${c.title}</div><div class="cert-sub">${c.sub || ''}</div>${viewLink}</div><button class="cert-del" onclick="removeCert(${i})" title="Remove">×</button></div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function addCert() {
  const t = document.getElementById('cert-title-input').value.trim();
  const s = document.getElementById('cert-sub-input').value.trim();
  if (!t) return;
  certs.push({ title: t, sub: s });
  document.getElementById('cert-title-input').value = '';
  document.getElementById('cert-sub-input').value = '';
  renderCerts();
}
function removeCert(i) { certs.splice(i, 1); renderCerts(); }
renderCerts();

// SCHOLARSHIPS
const scholarships = [
  { name: "Fulbright Scholarship", country: "USA", value: "Full funding (tuition + $15,000–18,000/year stipend)", eligibility: "Non-US citizens for US study; US citizens for abroad", deadline: "October (varies by country)", url: "https://fulbrightonline.org" },
  { name: "Chevening Scholarships", country: "UK", value: "Full funding (tuition + £1,300/month + flights)", eligibility: "Non-UK citizens with 2+ years work experience", deadline: "November 5", url: "https://chevening.org" },
  { name: "DAAD Scholarships", country: "Germany", value: "€934/month stipend + tuition waiver (varies)", eligibility: "International students for study in Germany", deadline: "October–November (varies)", url: "https://daad.de" },
  { name: "MEXT Scholarship", country: "Japan", value: "Full tuition + ¥117,000–145,000/month + airfare", eligibility: "Students from countries with Japanese embassies", deadline: "May–June (embassy track)", url: "https://www.mext.go.jp/en/policy/education/highered/title02/detail02/sdetail02/1373897.htm" },
  { name: "CSC Chinese Government Scholarship", country: "China", value: "Full tuition + CNY 2,500–3,500/month + accommodation", eligibility: "Non-Chinese students; 35+ countries bilateral", deadline: "March–April", url: "https://csc.edu.cn" },
  { name: "Swedish Institute Scholarships (SISGP)", country: "Sweden", value: "Full tuition + SEK 11,000/month", eligibility: "Students from 38 countries for Swedish master's", deadline: "February", url: "https://si.se/en/apply/scholarships/swedish-institute-scholarships-for-global-professionals/" },
  { name: "Eiffel Excellence Scholarship", country: "France", value: "€1,181–1,400/month for master's/PhD", eligibility: "International students for French universities", deadline: "January", url: "https://campusfrance.org" },
  { name: "GKS / KGSP Scholarship", country: "South Korea", value: "Full tuition + KRW 900,000/month + airfare + Korean language", eligibility: "Non-Korean students from 120+ countries", deadline: "March (embassy) / September (university)", url: "https://studyinkorea.go.kr" },
  { name: "Australia Awards", country: "Australia", value: "Full funding (tuition + AUD 30,000+/year)", eligibility: "Students from developing countries (65 countries)", deadline: "April–July (varies by country)", url: "https://australiaawards.gov.au" },
  { name: "Commonwealth Scholarships", country: "UK", value: "Full funding (tuition + living allowance + flights)", eligibility: "Commonwealth country citizens for UK postgrad", deadline: "October–December", url: "https://cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk" },
  { name: "Erasmus+ Program", country: "EU", value: "€500–800/month mobility grant", eligibility: "EU/EEA students for exchange at partner universities", deadline: "Varies by home institution", url: "https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu" },
  { name: "Swiss Excellence Scholarships", country: "Switzerland", value: "Full funding (CHF 1,920/month + tuition)", eligibility: "Non-Swiss researchers for postgrad in Switzerland", deadline: "November–February (varies)", url: "https://www.sbfi.admin.ch/sbfi/en/home/education/scholarships-and-grants/swiss-government-excellence-scholarships.html" }
];
const countries = ["All", ...[...new Set(scholarships.map(s => s.country))]];
let activeFilter = "All";
function renderFilters() {
  document.getElementById('schol-filters').innerHTML = countries.map(c =>
    `<button class="filter-btn${c === activeFilter ? ' active' : ''}" onclick="setFilter('${c}')">${c}</button>`
  ).join('');
}
function setFilter(c) { activeFilter = c; renderFilters(); renderSchol(); }
function renderSchol() {
  const list = activeFilter === "All" ? scholarships : scholarships.filter(s => s.country === activeFilter);
  document.getElementById('schol-grid').innerHTML = list.map(s => `
    <div class="schol-card">
      <div class="schol-header">
        <div class="schol-name">${s.name}</div>
        <div class="country-tag">${s.country}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="schol-val">${s.value}</div>
      <div class="schol-row">Eligibility: <span>${s.eligibility}</span></div>
      <div class="schol-row">Deadline: <span>${s.deadline}</span></div>
      <a class="schol-link" href="${s.url}" target="_blank">Official site →</a>
    </div>`).join('');
}
renderFilters(); renderSchol();

// FORM
const stepLabels = ["Basic info", "Academics", "Preferences", "Constraints", "Additional"];
let currentStep = 0;
function renderProgress() {
  document.getElementById('form-progress').innerHTML = stepLabels.map((l, i) =>
    `<div class="fp${i === currentStep ? ' active' : i < currentStep ? ' done' : ''}" onclick="goStep(${i})">${l}</div>`
  ).join('');
  document.getElementById('step-indicator').textContent = `Step ${currentStep + 1} of ${stepLabels.length}`;
  document.getElementById('btn-back').style.display = currentStep > 0 ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('btn-next').style.display = currentStep < stepLabels.length - 1 ? '' : 'none';
}
function goStep(n) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.form-step').forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('visible', i === n));
  currentStep = n; renderProgress();
}
function navForm(dir) { goStep(Math.max(0, Math.min(stepLabels.length - 1, currentStep + dir))); }
function submitForm() {
  document.getElementById('form-body').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('success-msg').style.display = 'block';
}
renderProgress();
</script>

<div id="cert-modal" style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.75);z-index:9999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:2rem;">
  <div style="position:relative;max-width:900px;width:100%;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;">
    <button onclick="closeCertModal()" style="position:absolute;top:10px;right:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.55);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:50%;width:30px;height:30px;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;z-index:10;line-height:1;">&#215;</button>
    <img id="cert-modal-img" src="" alt="Certificate" style="width:100%;display:block;" />
  </div>
</div>
<script>
function openCertModal(i){var m=document.getElementById('cert-modal');document.getElementById('cert-modal-img').src=certs[i].img;m.style.display='flex';}
function closeCertModal(){document.getElementById('cert-modal').style.display='none';}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){var m=document.getElementById('cert-modal');if(e.target===m)closeCertModal();});
</script>
</body>
</html>
